results.title: Information leakage - Global Trading
results.content: **Unavoidable** “It would be impossible to have zero information leakage,” states Hugh Spencer, global head of equity trading at Janus Henderson. “Part of what makes this so hard as a problem is that there’s market impact at every time scale, and it has very different forms and effects,” explains Allison Bishop, president and co-founder of execution-only broker-dealer Proof Trading. “We need to find different solutions or execution protocols to be competitive and reduce trade information leakage,” the French buyside trader affirms. The French senior buyside trader agrees that pre-trade optimisation is crucial; “we need to be sure that we have enough real-time information to demonstrate that we have achieved the best price,” he explains, “and that’s a challenge.”. “We combine passive activities and liquidity synching before going to the lit markets because we know that information leakage could be more pronounced there,” the senior French buyside trader confirms.

results.title: What prevents MOSFET drain-to-gate leakage current?
results.content: # What prevents MOSFET drain-to-gate leakage current? What in the structure of a MOSFET prevents leakage current flowing from the drain to the gate of a MOSFET when the drain is at a higher potential than the gate? Power MOSFETs have an asymmetric vertical structure, like this: The breakdown voltage is determined by the characteristics of the N region between the drain and gate. One explanation could be, avalanche is made to occur in the space between gate trenches, so the hot carriers are relatively distant from it; but I don't know what families, if any, have such a feature.) results.title: What is Target Leakage and how can you Stop it?
results.content: **H2O Driverless AI:** Accelerate model development with automatic feature engineering and explainability No-Code Deep Learning. * Overfitting in Machine Learning | H2O.ai Wiki. # Target Leakage. ## What is Target Leakage? Target leakage can happen when a variable that is not a feature is being used to predict the target. This results in the model overfitting to the training data and produces a higher accuracy when run on unseen data than it would have if the model had not fit the training dataset. Try to think about target leakage occurring over time when new data becomes available and changes existing data used in the model. This results in target leakage. ## Why is Target Leakage Important? Target leakage is a consistent problem in data science and machine learning. Kaggle contestants have been known to intentionally include sampling errors that result in target leakage as a way to develop accurate models and gain competitive advantages in data science competitions. Try to avoid target leakage by omitting data that is not known at the time of the target outcome. Label leakage happens when information that is not available at the time of prediction leaks into the training set used for model training. **H2O.ai and Big Data:**H2O AI is a platform that helps data scientists apply Big Data to their datasets much faster. H2O allows data scientists to get past the technology layer that changes daily and get straight to making, operating, and innovating with AI. H2O.ai enables teams of data scientists, developers, machine-learning engineers, DevOps, IT professionals, and business users to work together with the same toolset toward a common goal. ## H2O.ai and Target Leakage:. ### H2O Driverless AI and Leakage Detection. Driverless AI runs a model to determine the predictive power of each feature on the target variable. ### How can I find features that may be causing data leakages in my Driverless AI model? ### How Driverless AI Prevents Overfitting and Leakage. In Driverless AI, we take special measures in various stages of the modeling process to ensure that overfitting is prevented and that all models produced are generalizable and give consistent results on test data. Since Driverless AI thrives in making very predictive models, it has built-in measures to control overfitting and underfitting.
